issues.explanation: Chapter 16 calls Lü Bu’s daughter’s intended destination an imperial consort position (“皇妃”), while Chapter 17 correctly identifies her as the crown prince’s consort (“太子妃”/“东宫妃”). This creates a cross-chapter inconsistency in Yuan Shu’s marriage demand and political setup.
issues.suggested_fix: In Chapter 16, replace “送女入宫做皇妃” with “送女入宫做太子妃” (or “东宫妃”).
